::: {#def-prediction}
#### Prediction

A **prediction** (or **predicted value**) $\fitted(x)$
of the outcome $Y$ at covariate value $x$
is a value computed from data $(x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)$ and from $x$,
used as a guess of the value that $Y$ takes when $X = x$:

$$\fitted(x) \eqdef \hat{f}(x),$$

where $\hat{f}$ is a function fitted to those data.
:::
